narrative: 当互不相容的事实必须共存于同一个空间中时使用：无聊与危险并存，笑话与伤口并存，后备箱里的一颗炸弹和正在聊天的人们并存。观众的目光扫过一个正在运转的真实世界，而不是被喂进一个插入镜头。
时长本身就是张力。密集的人群还不够。
每个区域都需要一个与摄影机节奏相匹配的、清晰可辨的动作。当这场戏是一次可能藏着接点的炫技式镜头运动，或者覆盖镜头应该只聚焦一张脸时，它就不是合适的工具。
一镜到底（Oner）是设计成看起来像一个镜头、但可能被拼接过的。长镜头（Long Take）所主张的是连续的真实时间。
不要把一个静态特写举两分钟，就说这份耐力是一个全景。
how: 在一条共享的时间线上，为前景、中景和背景做调度。给摄影机一条清晰的路线（斯坦尼康、摇臂、手持，或影棚推轨），并在不失去人物这个锚点的前提下变换它的注意力。
排练接触点、视线方向和额外的调度动作，让这个镜头能够撑得下去。提示词：Long take covering [Subject] without a cut, duration as tension, blocking and camera choreographed as one sentence.
when: 当观众必须留在这个房间里时使用，比如一辆车不能在枪林弹雨袭来时切走。不要把它用来炫耀一段走廊漫步，而纵深里什么都没有发生。
vs: 长镜头强调的是连续的时长。一镜到底设计成不带可见剪辑点，可能藏有拼接。
斯坦尼康（Steadicam）是一种支撑设备，而不是对时长的主张。隐形剪辑（Invisible Cut）是一些一镜到底用来取巧的手法。
主镜头（Master Shot）覆盖整场戏的动作，以便后期能够剪辑。长镜头往往就是这场戏本身。
examples_film: 《人类之子》（Children of Men）把汽车戏和分娩戏保持在连续不断的危险之中。《大玩家》（The Player）开场用一个移动的长句，把整个片场里的对话串联起来。
《历劫佳人》（Touch of Evil）跟拍一辆装有炸弹的汽车，而附近的人们浑然不知。《赎罪》（Atonement）中的敦刻尔克海滩段落，穿梭于士兵、残骸和四散的活动之中。
《俄罗斯方舟》（Russian Ark）和《维多利亚》（Victoria）把这场赌注延伸到了整部长片的长度。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是被拼接过、却宣称是一镜到底真相的镜头，或者一个人群拥挤、却没有任何计时动作的宽镜头。破绽是猛地甩入黑暗、一辆穿过画面的卡车，或者临时演员只是单纯占据空间。
解决办法是：一个明确的长镜头，纵深中有各自独立的动作，一条摄影机路线，以及一个人物锚点。

faq.q: 电影中的长镜头是什么？
faq.a: 长镜头是一个异常延长的镜头，让表演、空间和时长在没有明显剪辑点的情况下保持连续。

faq.q: 长镜头和一镜到底有什么区别？
faq.a: 长镜头主张的是连续的实拍时长。一镜到底设计成看起来是一个镜头，只要接点不露痕迹，就可以包含隐形拼接。
当离开这个房间会泄掉张力时使用，并且纵深中的世界必须围绕我们跟随的人物继续运转。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示长镜头？
faq.a: 写明一个没有剪辑点的连续镜头，一条摄影机路线，以及前景、中景、背景中各自独立的动作。指明这个人物锚点。

narrative: Use it when incompatible facts must coexist in one geography: boredom beside danger, a joke beside a wound, a bomb in a trunk while people chat. The eye scans a functioning world instead of consuming an insert.
Duration is the tension. A dense crowd is not enough.
Each zone needs an intelligible action timed to the camera. It is the wrong tool when the scene is a virtuoso ride that may hide joins, or when coverage should isolate a face.
A oner is designed to play as one take and may be stitched. A long take's claim is continuous time.
Do not hold a static close-up for two minutes and call the endurance a panorama.
how: Block foreground, midground, and background on a shared timeline. Give the camera a clear route (Steadicam, crane, handheld, or studio dolly) and vary its attention without losing the human anchor.
Rehearse contacts, eyelines, and extra business so the take can survive. Prompt: Long take covering [Subject] without a cut, duration as tension, blocking and camera choreographed as one sentence.
when: Use it when the audience must stay in the room, such as a car that cannot cut away from incoming gunfire. Do not use it to show off a corridor walk with nothing happening in depth.
vs: A long take emphasizes continuous duration. A Oner is designed to play without visible edits and may hide stitches.
Steadicam is a support, not a duration claim. An Invisible Cut is how some oners cheat.
A Master Shot covers the action so the scene can be cut. A long take often is the scene.
examples_film: Children of Men keeps car and birth passages inside continuous danger. The Player opens by walking conversations across a studio lot in one moving sentence.
Touch of Evil follows a bomb car while nearby people remain unaware. Atonement 's Dunkirk beach moves among soldiers, wreckage, and stranded activity.
Russian Ark and Victoria extend the wager to feature length.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a stitched Oner sold as uncut truth, or a crowded wide with no timed business. The tell is a whip into darkness, a crossing truck, or extras who only occupy space.
Fix: one overt take, distinct actions in depth, a camera route, and a human anchor.

faq.q: What is Long Take in film?
faq.a: A long take is an unusually extended shot that keeps performance, space, and duration continuous without an overt cut.
A long take claims continuous recorded time. A oner is designed to play as one take and may include invisible stitches as long as the joins do not read.

faq.q: When should I use Long Take?
faq.a: When leaving the room would leak tension, and the world in depth must keep working around the people we follow.

faq.q: How do I prompt Long Take for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write an unbroken take with no cut, a camera route, and separate actions in foreground, midground, and background. Name the human anchor.
